page_title: BRA 1-2 NOR | Brazil v Norway 05/07/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+12' Ismail Elfath is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+10' 1 - 2 GOAL! Neymar (Brazil) sends the penalty kick into the right of the net.
90+10' Neymar (Brazil) is going to take the penalty!
90+9' The referee blows his whistle as Leo Ostigard (Norway) was too aggressive in his challenge. The referee points to the penalty spot. It's a penalty for Brazil!
90+6' Neymar (Brazil) has tested the patience of referee Ismail Elfath and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
90+5' Substitution. David Wolfe leaves the pitch and is replaced by Leo Ostigard (Norway).
90+3' Ederson (Brazil) receives a good pass and from just outside the box he unleashes a promising strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
90+2' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Danilo Santos (Brazil).
90' 7 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' 0 - 2 Goal! Andreas Schjelderup slips it to Erling Haaland (Norway) on the edge of the box and he finds the bottom right corner with a great effort. The score is 0:2.
89' The ball is cleared after Vinicius Junior (Brazil) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Norway.
88' Martin Odegaard (Norway) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.

88' Martin Odegaard (Norway) creates himself some space and attempts to put the ball into the box. However, the defender gets an important foot in to clear. The ball is out of play. Norway win a corner kick.
86' Casemiro (Brazil) makes a yard for himself inside the box after an accurate pass and takes a shot that goes just wide of the right post.
83' The attendance is 80663.
83' The corner from Neymar (Brazil) is cleared away by the defence.
82' Neymar (Brazil) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance. Brazil have been awarded a corner kick.
82' The ball is cleared after Vinicius Junior (Brazil) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The referee points to the corner flag and Brazil will take a corner.

79' 0 - 1 It's in! Erling Haaland (Norway) finds space in the box and from close range powers an unstoppable header into the right of the goal after a cheeky lofted pass from Andreas Schjelderup. 0:1.
79' Bruno Guimaraes will be replaced by Ederson (Brazil).
75' Alisson pulls off a great save to deny Andreas Schjelderup (Norway), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick shot to the left side of the goal.
72' Martin Odegaard (Norway) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
68' The referee blows his whistle and players are going to refresh themselves.
67' Substitution. Rayan is replaced by Danilo Santos (Brazil).
67' Here is a change. Gabriel Martinelli is going off and Carlo Ancelotti gives the last tactical orders to Neymar (Brazil).
67' Erling Haaland (Norway) gets in a good position inside the box and is only inches away from getting on the end of a through ball from the edge of the area.
66' Martin Odegaard (Norway) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.
66' Andreas Schjelderup (Norway) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Alisson intercepts the ball. Norway have been awarded a corner kick.
63' It will be a substitution. Fredrik Aursnes (Norway) is ready to enter the pitch as Julian Ryerson walks off.
63' Rayan (Brazil) is forced to stop his forward run after being caught in an offside position by the linesman.

62' A neat pass is well received by Rayan (Brazil), who is lurking on the edge of the box and produces a low drive directed towards the middle of the goal. The goalkeeper makes a decent save to block his shot.
62' Bruno Guimaraes (Brazil) launches a cross from the corner, but Orjan Nyland is alert to thwart the effort.
61' Endrick (Brazil) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.
59' Endrick (Brazil) receives a brilliant pass and wastes a big opportunity as his shot from inside the penalty area flies narrowly wide of the left post.
58' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Endrick (Brazil) replaces Matheus Cunha.
57' Andreas Schjelderup (Norway) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The ball has crossed the sideline. Brazil are taking a throw-in.
55' The resulting corner from Matheus Cunha (Brazil) is cleared by the opposition's defence.

54' Vinicius Junior (Brazil) sends a pass into the box, but the opposition's defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance. Brazil force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
53' David Wolfe (Norway) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.

51' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Norway are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
49' Patrick Berg (Norway) produces an awful long-range shot that goes high and wide.
47' Rayan (Brazil) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
46' Stale Solbakken has made a change at the break. Andreas Schjelderup (Norway) has come on in place of Antonio Nusa.
46' Here is a change after the half-time break. Alexander Sorloth is replaced by Oscar Bobb (Norway).
46' The second half has just started.
45+7' The end of the first half.
45+6' Vinicius Junior (Brazil) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The ball goes out of play and Norway will have a goal kick.
45+5' Gabriel Martinelli (Brazil) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball.
45+4' Bruno Guimaraes (Brazil) receives a pass and fires a shot in from long range, but it's blocked.
45+3' Martin Odegaard (Norway) picks up a rebound inside the penalty area and drills a shot to the middle of the goal, but is denied by a reflex save from Alisson.
45+2' A dangerous looking corner kick from Martin Odegaard (Norway) is cleared to safety by the defence.

45+1' Julian Ryerson (Norway) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it. The referee blows his whistle, Norway are awarded a corner kick.
45' The fourth official shows 6 min. of added time.
43' Patrick Berg (Norway) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.

43' Martin Odegaard (Norway) received a pass inside the box and sent a dangerous shot in on goal, but keep the champagne on ice as one of the defenders stepped in and blocked the effort. It's hard to say whether the keeper would have stopped it. The ball goes out for a corner. Norway can continue in their attacking effort.
41' Brazil take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
40' Vinicius Junior (Brazil) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a low drive towards the middle of the net, but Orjan Nyland is alert and denies him.
40' Casemiro (Brazil) received a pass out of defence and immediately attempted a long-range shot, but a defender bravely blocked the effort.
38' Gabriel Martinelli (Brazil) commits a rough challenge and Ismail Elfath blows his whistle for a foul.
37' Erling Haaland (Norway) gets on the end of a cross inside the box and sweeps the ball goalwards towards the middle of the goal, but Alisson is well positioned and easily deals with the effort.
36' Martin Odegaard (Norway) has to stretch for the ball in the box and sends it just wide of the right post.
33' Antonio Nusa (Norway) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
30' Half-chance! Danilo (Brazil) plays a pass into the box, but Orjan Nyland reacts well to snuff out the attack.
27' The referee blows for a cooling break.
24' PENALTY APPEAL after Matheus Cunha (Brazil) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
23' Ismail Elfath blows his whistle for a foul after Rayan (Brazil) hacks down one of his opponents. A free kick has been awarded to Norway.
20' 33:67 – the ratio of ball possession.
19' Gabriel Martinelli (Brazil) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Orjan Nyland comes off the line to clear the ball away.
18' Vinicius Junior (Brazil) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
17' Rayan (Brazil) makes a good run with the ball into the box, but mishits his shot as it goes well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Norway.
16' Julian Ryerson (Norway) tackles a bit over-zealously and Ismail Elfath blows for a foul.

14' Bruno Guimaraes (Brazil) steps up to the penalty spot. He attempts to confuse the goalkeeper by stopping in the middle of his run up and sends the ball to the right side of the target, but Orjan Nyland keeps his cool to thwart him.
13' Bruno Guimaraes (Brazil) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
13' The Brazil players are happy as the referee awards a PENALTY after the VAR review!
11' There's a break in play and referee Ismail Elfath must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by Brazil using VAR. This could be interesting!
10' Matheus Cunha (Brazil) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
9' Vinicius Junior (Brazil) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play. The ball goes out of play and Norway will have a goal kick.
6' Martin Odegaard (Norway) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.
5' A lofted cross from Alexander Sorloth (Norway) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area. Norway force a corner. They send men into the box.
4' Patrick Berg (Norway) has a goal ruled out for offside!
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
Norway will kick the game off.
